content: We have carbon NMR data with chemical shifts. Need count of methyl groups in the molecule. Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm (sp3). In data we have peaks at 37.50, 36.39, 26.41. Those could be methyl or methylene. Typically methyl ~ 10-30, but 26-40 could be CH2 or CH3 attached to aromatic or carbonyl. Need more info. Could also get proton NMR to identify methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). Let's get proton NMR.
